summary: This paper provides a definitive classification of positive-slope relative-bound equiangular line families, establishes exact fixed-angle thresholds, and extends consecutive-dimension results beyond Bukh and Cox. By proving exact alternating-character eigenvalue bounds and seed-eigenvector extensions, the author uncovers four new infinite fixed-angle families (Tetrahedron, Petersen, Clebsch, Higman-Sims), sharpens existing thresholds for E_7 and Leech configurations, and proves zero-gap adjacent-dimension contact. Furthermore, conference-matrix constructions are extended to entire consecutive intervals of length (sqrt(m^2+2m)-m)t + O(1), and an exact s >= 4 impossibility barrier for block-diagonal configurations is established. Every algebraic theorem is formally proven in constructive Lean 4.35.0 (18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) and backed by 16 AST-audited zero-float certificates, representing a landmark contribution to extremal combinatorics.
